How come when I downvote a post that is already negative, it turns positive?

When you first see a post you see the total score. Once you vote it changes the displayed score to the total number of votes that match yours.

Say a post has 5 upvotes and 9 downvotes, you'll see it as -4. If you upvote you'll see the number change to 6 because it has 6 total upvotes. If you downvote you'll see it change to 10 because it has 10 total downvotes.
